scope: This artifact curates five closed test contexts, the closed ordinary quality checks, the ordinary eight-file source checkpoint, and the actual clean-source and post-fresh context records. It is evidence for bounded qualification and is not a declaration that P0-15, the whole plan, CI or release is complete.

curation.readBoundary: The four original contexts are preserved from the unchanged predecessor audit. This successor curator read that audit and three closed outcome files, then verified every new embedded raw-to-observer identity, occurrence and state join. Whole primary file references are preserved from the actual outcome records. Individual primary files, source files, native modules and transitive inventories were not reread in this successor curation task.
curation.projectionBoundary: Ordered identities, states, hooks and failure headers are curated projections, not byte-for-byte replacements for raw reports. Each RED failure retains its first test-body frame and explicit reach limit. Complete original raw, observer and log byte hashes remain referenced.

population.description: The 29-case regression file is contained in the later 30-case file. That file is contained in the population of 87 cases across seven files. Both current-root contexts and the new dedicated fresh context preserve the same 87 ordered identities. There are 320 recorded run observations across five contexts, not 320 unique tests; the canonical population remains 87.
population.rawSuiteCountBoundary: Vitest raw suite counters include nested suites. The rawFiles arrays record actual test files.

sourceEpoch.description: The first test-only regression candidate ran against the original production sources and original compiled domain implementation.
